definitions: A group of steroid hormones that promote the development and maintenance of female characteristics of the body.

Any of several hormones produced in the ovaries and placenta that are responsible for the development and maintenance of female secondary sexual characteristics and for the cyclical changes in the uterine lining.
examples: Estrogen levels fluctuate during the menstrual cycle.
Hormone replacement therapy often includes estrogen.
The drug blocks the effects of estrogen.
